query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM location WHERE world_id = ?1 AND deleted = 0) AS "locations!: i64", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connection WHERE world_id = ?1 AND deleted = 0) AS "connections!: i64", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "group" WHERE world_id = ?1 AND deleted = 0) AS "groups!: i64", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM character WHERE world_id = ?1 AND role = 'npc' AND deleted = 0) AS "npcs!: i64", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_type WHERE world_id = ?1 AND deleted = 0) AS "item_types!: i64", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item WHERE world_id = ?1 AND deleted = 0) AS "items!: i64"
